_about: Water (1) + ethyl acetate (2): mutual solubilities (liquid-liquid equilibrium) from 298.15 K to 333.15 K, binary data from Grande and Marschoff (2005). Phase I is the water-rich phase, phase II the ester-rich phase. Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: T in K, mole fraction of water in phase I, mole fraction of water in phase II.

source.citation: M. del C. Grande, C. M. Marschoff, Liquid-Liquid Equilibria for Water + Benzonitrile + Ethyl Acetate or + Butyl Acetate, J. Chem. Eng. Data 50 (2005) 1324-1327
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1 (mole fraction of water in liquid mixture 1) and 2 (mole fraction of water in liquid mixture 2), compounds 1 ethyl acetate and 2 water. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Pressure constraint 101.3 kPa in the record. No uncertainties given in the record for these two sets. The water content of the ester-rich phase (0.1733 at 298.15 K) is higher than Cehreli et al. (2006, 0.1323 at 298.2 K, water_ethyl-acetate_lle_cehreli2006.json); the two open sources disagree by about 30 % there. Read twice from the ThermoML Archive (XML and JSON files), both reads identical.
